verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair question for a web-crawling library with a self-hosted server, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no documented scheduler, cron, or recurring-job feature. Crash recovery via resume_state, one-off CLI and arun runs, and community n8n bridging are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not first-party recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
